metadata.title: {agency} — Authentic Cuban travel

home.description: Ecotourism, agrotourism, and cultural immersion beyond the resort circuits — curated with Cuban communities.
home.preparing: The catalog is being prepared. Check back soon.

checkout.mockDescription: This is a development stand-in for the payment gateway.

build.title: Build your itinerary
build.description: Pick your dates and the stays, transport, and experiences you want. We will assemble the itinerary and start securing providers.
build.dateError: The end date must be on or after the start date.
build.noOptions: No options in this category yet — continue to the next step.
build.addAtLeastOne: Add at least one service before submitting.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your email and we will send a one-time link to your bookings and documents.
login.sent: Check your inbox — a sign-in link is on its way to {email}.
login.error: Could not send the sign-in link.

account.title: My trips
account.empty: No bookings yet. Explore the catalog to start planning.
account.documentsEmpty: Vouchers and invoices appear here once your booking is confirmed.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Chat with our operations team about this booking.

banner.text: Cultural events across Cuba — ask our team for the current calendar.

join.title: Join our network
join.description: Guides, drivers, homestay hosts, and translators — apply below. Our team reviews every application and will be in touch about compliance and onboarding.
join.cardDescription: We use these details only for onboarding and compliance.
join.sent: Thank you — your application is in. Our operations team will review it and get back to you.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your work email and we will send you a one-time sign-in link.
login.sent: Check your inbox — a sign-in link is on its way to {email}. Locally it lands in Mailpit at http://localhost:8025.
login.error: Could not send the sign-in link.

board.title: Reservations
board.description: The operations pipeline, grouped by status. Open a booking to transition, inspect, and audit it.
board.empty: No reservations yet. Create one, or run the seed, to populate the pipeline.

reservation.bookingDescription: Status transitions are governed by the domain state machine.
reservation.paymentsDescription: Payment links are generated at SECURED_AND_INVOICED; confirming clears funds and confirms the booking.
reservation.noServiceItems: No service items on this booking yet.
reservation.noDocuments: No documents yet. Confirm the booking, or use the Documents page to regenerate.

reservationActions.viewOnly: Your role can view this reservation but not change its status.

candidates.empty: No eligible supplier for this item.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Worker and provider compliance. A verified, in-province supplier is eligible for dispatch.
suppliers.expiring: {count} credential(s) expiring within 30 days — auto-dispatch is paused:

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: Supplier recruitment. Approving an application creates the worker account and compliance profile.
applications.empty: No applications yet. The public form lives at /join-our-network.

dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.description: Offers, deadlines, and escalation state for a reservation's service items.
dispatch.noServiceItems: No service items on this reservation.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.description: Live dispatch and timeout monitoring for the operations desk. Amber at 75%, red at 100% or on decline.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Traveler↔operations conversations. Replies reach the traveler live, with an email fallback when they are offline.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Vouchers, work orders, and invoices generated from the tenant-branded templates.
documents.empty: No documents yet. Confirming a reservation generates them, or use regenerate.

escalationBoard.description: Amber at 75% of the deadline, red at 100% or on decline/timeout.
escalationBoard.nothing: Nothing is in the dispatch or escalation flow right now.

messageThread.offline: offline — messages still save and email

supplierDetail.credentialDescription: Formatur credential, transport operating licence, or RTN card.
supplierDetail.availabilityDescription: Single-tap availability and granular blocking. Auto-dispatch respects these days (spec §5.2).

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Financial, operational, and quality KPIs (spec §4.9). Bounds are by record creation date.
analytics.noPaid: No paid receipts in this window.
analytics.packageDescription: Pre-assembled curated packages vs custom itineraries
analytics.noServices: No services booked in this window.

quality.title: Quality & duty of care
quality.description: Incident log and worker reliability scorecards (spec §4.9.4).
quality.reliabilityDescription: Derived from the dispatch-offer ledger; best acceptance first.

regulatory.title: Regulatory reporting
regulatory.description: MINTUR annual activity summary and ecotourism ratio (spec §4.9.2). Bounds filter by booking creation date; bed-nights are per booking until a party size is recorded.
regulatory.loadError: Could not load the regulatory report.
regulatory.classificationDescription: Ecotourism, agrotourism, and nature qualify for the specialised-traffic ratio (Resolución 193/2026).
regulatory.noServices: No services booked in this window.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: GDPR lifecycle for travelers: a keep-alive notice 6 months after the last completed booking, a 30-day grace period, then anonymization.
retention.pipelineDescription: Travelers with a notice due, inside the grace period, or due for anonymization. Anonymized records keep their reservations and fiscal totals.
retention.empty: No travelers are in the retention lifecycle.

imports.title: Imports
imports.description: Stage a CSV or XLSX, map its columns, then commit the batch as inventory.
imports.bulkImportDescription: Commit validates the whole batch atomically — a single bad row imports nothing.

packagesPage.title: Curated packages
packagesPage.description: Multi-day templates built from catalog items (spec §3.3). Booking a package expands it into a reservation's service items.
packagesPage.name: Name

intake.title: New reservation
intake.description: Ops-side intake. The storefront builder will submit the same shape at ITINERARY_SUBMITTED.
intake.bookingDetailsDescription: Bookings start in DRAFT and advance through legal transitions.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Catalog, media, and pricing. Seasonal rates and markups feed the pure domain pricing engine.

inventory.name: Name

inventoryDetail.imagesDescription: Shown on the public catalog. Images of inactive items are not served.
inventoryDetail.pricingRulesDescription: Seasonal rates override the base price; markups stack on top.
inventoryDetail.noRules: No pricing rules; the base price applies year-round.
